SELECT icm.braking_point_m, icm.corner_name, icm.track_id, rc.track_id AS rc_track_id, dc.circuit_name, icm.race_year, icm.driver_id
FROM int_corner_metrics icm
JOIN race_to_track rc ON icm.race_id = rc.race_id
JOIN dim_circuits dc ON rc.track_id = dc.circuit_id
WHERE icm.driver_id='VER' AND icm.race_year=2024 AND icm.corner_name='Turn 1' AND dc.circuit_name='Monza'
LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT icm.corner_name
FROM int_corner_metrics icm
JOIN race_to_track rc ON icm.race_id = rc.race_id
JOIN dim_circuits dc ON rc.track_id = dc.circuit_id
WHERE icm.driver_id='VER' AND icm.race_year=2024 AND dc.circuit_name='Monza'
LIMIT 20
